_README: Reading state for the guidebook knowledge DB. Read this before resuming. The project-wide state.json one level up is the site's record; this one only tracks book reading.
next_action: Ask the user to borrow the next book. Recommended order: Lonely Planet 2017 full guide first (most practical detail, closest to today), then Moon 2015, then Insight 2015 (culture), Goscha (history-context.json), LP phrasebook last. Before asking, find the correct archive.org ID for the LP 2017 full guide — vietnam0000stew_v3m3 is 'Discover Vietnam'.
method_notes: printed page P = leaf n(P+5) for dk-2015; other books will have their own offset — find it from the contents page first
get_page_text returns ~1.2 KB of archive.org boilerplate per page; batches of 6–8 pages per browser_batch call are the sweet spot
image-heavy pages (maps, climate charts, timeline spreads) OCR badly; screenshot + zoom if a figure matters
write paraphrased notes to raw-notes/<book>-notes.md after every batch; never store OCR text
fact_wishlist_note: fact-wishlist.md lists ~55 fact keys the books quantify that facts.json lacks, with the primary source to settle each. P1 rows are candidates for the next facts build.
